identity.name: IE-cont-Llama3.1-8B
identity.summary: The model is a continual-pretrained variant trained on the IEpile dataset.

possible_risks.description: A membership inference attack repeatedly queries a model to determine if a given input was part of the model's training. More specifically, given a trained model and a data sample, an attacker appropriately samples the input space, observing outputs to deduce whether that sample was part of the model's training.
possible_risks.justification: continual-pretrained on IEpile dataset with open weights; if IEpile contains sensitive or identifiable data, the released model can be queried to infer training membership.

possible_risks.description: Applicable laws can establish data subject rights such as opt-out rights, right to access, and right to be forgotten. Synthetic data might raise unique concerns, such as the potential for reidentification of individuals from seemingly anonymous synthetic data. Data subject rights might also be relevant in scenarios where synthetic data is derived from sensitive or personal information.
possible_risks.justification: continual-pretrained on IEpile dataset; continual pretraining on a domain dataset may encode personal health information from epilepsy-related data, raising data subject rights concerns.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: dense decoder-only continual-pretrained language model with no reported evaluation or guardrails; can generate factually inaccurate content.

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight model with MIT license and no stated use restrictions; users may prompt it with copyrighted text, and the card does not address IP handling.

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight model with no stated privacy safeguards; users may include confidential information in prompts when using the checkpoint.
